item.name: Jo Example
item.profile_text: Jo Example - Controller at Bramblewood Clinics. I run accounting and the monthly close for our twelve clinic entities. Recent post (2 weeks ago): we cut our close from 12 days to 8 by moving intercompany reconciliations out of spreadsheets.

queries: "Jo Example" podcast OR talk OR interview

problem: Month-end close takes too long for multi-entity companies; usually owned by the controller or VP Finance.
